# Crossplane XRD + Composition: VersionedBucket

This implementation provides a Composite Resource Definition and Composition using function-patch-and-transform mode, provisioning S3 (with versioning/encryption), RDS PostgreSQL (deletion protection), and IAM roles across dev/prod environments.

## 1. CompositeResourceDefinition (XRD)

```yaml
# apis/versionedbucket-xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: versionedbuckets.infra.example.com
spec:
  group: infra.example.com
  names:
    kind: VersionedBucket
    plural: versionedbuckets
  claimNames:
    kind: BucketClaim
    plural: bucketclaims
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            required:
            - environment
            - bucketName
            - dbInstanceClass
            properties:
              # Environment selector: controls resource sizing and features
              environment:
                type: string
                enum: ["dev", "prod"]
                description: "Deployment environment controlling instance sizing and replication"
              
              # AWS Region
              region:
                type: string
                default: "us-east-1"
                description: "Primary AWS region"
              
              # S3 Configuration
              bucketName:
                type: string
                minLength: 3
                maxLength: 63
                description: "S3 bucket name (globally unique)"
              
              enableReplication:
                type: boolean
                description: "Enable cross-region replication (prod only)"
              
              replicationRegion:
                type: string
                default: "us-west-2"
                description: "Replication destination region for prod"
              
              # RDS Configuration
              dbInstanceClass:
                type: string
                enum:
                - db.t3.micro    # dev
                - db.t3.small
                - db.t3.medium   # prod
                - db.t3.large
                description: "RDS instance type"
              
              dbName:
                type: string
                default: "appdb"
                description: "PostgreSQL database name"
              
              dbUsername:
                type: string
                default: "postgres"
                description: "Database master username"
              
              multiAZ:
                type: boolean
                description: "Enable Multi-AZ deployment (prod recommended)"
              
              backupRetentionDays:
                type: integer
                minimum: 7
                default: 7
                description: "RDS backup retention period in days"
              
              # IAM Configuration
              iamRoleName:
                type: string
                description: "IAM role name for service accounts"
              
              serviceAccountNamespace:
                type: string
                default: "default"
                description: "Kubernetes namespace for IRSA (prod: OIDC, dev: basic)"
              
              # Connection Secret
              writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                type: object
                required:
                - name
                properties:
                  name:
                    type: string
                  namespace:
                    type: string
                    default: "crossplane-system"
          
          status:
            type: object
            properties:
              bucketArn:
                type: string
              bucketName:
                type: string
              replicationBucketArn:
                type: string
              rdsEndpoint:
                type: string
              rdsPort:
                type: integer
              iamRoleArn:
                type: string
              conditions:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    type:
                      type: string
                    status:
                      type: string
                    reason:
                      type: string
```

## 2. Composition (function-patch-and-transform mode)

```yaml
# compositions/versionedbucket-composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: versionedbucket-ftop
  labels:
    stack: aws
    provider: upbound
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: infra.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: VersionedBucket
  
  mode: Pipeline
  
  pipeline:
  - step: patch-and-transform
    functionRef:
      name: crossplane-contrib-function-patch-and-transform
    input:
      apiVersion: pt.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      patchSets:
      - name: common-labels
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: metadata.labels
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: metadata.labels
          toFieldPath: status.labels
      
      - name: provider-config
        patches:
        - type: Value
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
          value: aws-provider-default
      
      resources:
      
      # ========== S3 BUCKET ==========
      - name: s3-bucket
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Bucket
          metadata:
            name: bucket  # will be patched
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              acl: private
              tags:
                ManagedBy: Crossplane
                Environment: dev
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        # Region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        
        # Bucket name
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
        
        # Environment tag
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags[Environment]
        
        # Export bucket ARN and name to status
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
          toFieldPath: status.bucketArn
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.id
          toFieldPath: status.bucketName
      
      # ========== S3 VERSIONING ==========
      - name: s3-bucket-versioning
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketVersioning
          metadata:
            name: versioning
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucket: ""
              versioningConfiguration:
              - status: Enabled
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
        - type: PatchSet
          patchSetName: provider-config
      
      # ========== S3 SERVER-SIDE ENCRYPTION ==========
      - name: s3-bucket-sse
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
          metadata:
            name: encryption
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucket: ""
              rule:
              - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                - sseAlgorithm: AES256
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
      
      # ========== S3 PUBLIC ACCESS BLOCK ==========
      - name: s3-bucket-pab
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
          metadata:
            name: pab
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucket: ""
              blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
      
      # ========== S3 REPLICATION (PROD ONLY) ==========
      - name: replication-bucket
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Bucket
          metadata:
            name: replication-bucket
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-west-2
              acl: private
              versioningConfiguration:
              - status: Enabled
              tags:
                ManagedBy: Crossplane
                Type: Replication
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.replicationRegion
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        
        # Bucket name: append -replica
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-replica"
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-replica"
        
        # Only create for prod
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags[ProdOnly]
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Convert
              convert: "true"
        
        # Export replica bucket to status
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
          toFieldPath: status.replicationBucketArn
      
      # ========== RDS SECURITY GROUP ==========
      - name: rds-sg
        base:
          apiVersion: ec2.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: SecurityGroup
          metadata:
            name: rds-sg
          spec:
            forProvider:
              groupDescription: "RDS PostgreSQL security group"
              vpcId: ""  # will be populated via external lookup or patch
              tags:
                Name: rds-sg
                ManagedBy: Crossplane
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags[Environment]
      
      # ========== RDS SECURITY GROUP INGRESS ==========
      - name: rds-sg-ingress
        base:
          apiVersion: ec2.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: SecurityGroupIngress
          metadata:
            name: rds-ingress
          spec:
            forProvider:
              type: ingress
              fromPort: 5432
              toPort: 5432
              protocol: tcp
              cidrBlocks:
              - "10.0.0.0/8"  # Private VPC range (adjust as needed)
              securityGroupId: ""  # backref to rds-sg
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
      
      # ========== DB SUBNET GROUP ==========
      - name: db-subnet-group
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: DBSubnetGroup
          metadata:
            name: db-subnet
          spec:
            forProvider:
              subnetIds: []  # will be patched
              tags:
                Name: db-subnet-group
                ManagedBy: Crossplane
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
      
      # ========== RDS PARAMETER GROUP (PostgreSQL) ==========
      - name: db-parameter-group
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: DBParameterGroup
          metadata:
            name: pg-params
          spec:
            forProvider:
              family: postgres15
              description: "PostgreSQL parameter group"
              tags:
                ManagedBy: Crossplane
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags[Environment]
      
      # ========== RDS INSTANCE ==========
      - name: rds-instance
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Instance
          metadata:
            name: postgres
          spec:
            forProvider:
              allocatedStorage: "20"
              engine: postgres
              engineVersion: "15.3"
              instanceClass: db.t3.micro
              dbName: appdb
              username: postgres
              passwordSecretRef:
                name: rds-password
                namespace: crossplane-system
                key: password
              publiclyAccessible: false
              skipFinalSnapshot: false
              finalSnapshotIdentifierPrefix: postgres-final
              backupRetentionPeriod: 7
              multiAZ: false
              storageEncrypted: true
              deletionProtection: true
              enableCloudwatchLogsExports:
              - postgresql
              tags:
                ManagedBy: Crossplane
                Database: postgres
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
            writeConnectionSecretToRef:
              name: rds-conn
              namespace: crossplane-system
        
        patches:
        # Region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        
        # Instance class
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceClass
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
        
        # Database name
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
        
        # Master username
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbUsername
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
        
        # Multi-AZ based on environment
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.multiAZ
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAZ
        
        # Backup retention
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.backupRetentionDays
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
        
        # Environment tag
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags[Environment]
        
        # Export endpoint
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
          toFieldPath: status.rdsEndpoint
        
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.port
          toFieldPath: status.rdsPort
      
      # ========== IAM ROLE (SERVICE ACCOUNT) ==========
      - name: iam-role
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Role
          metadata:
            name: app-service-role
          spec:
            forProvider:
              assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Principal": {
                        "Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"
                      },
                      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              tags:
                ManagedBy: Crossplane
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        # Role name
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
        
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.name
        
        # Environment tag
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags[Environment]
        
        # Export ARN
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
          toFieldPath: status.iamRoleArn
      
      # ========== IAM POLICY (S3 + RDS ACCESS) ==========
      - name: iam-policy
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Policy
          metadata:
            name: app-policy
          spec:
            forProvider:
              policy: ""  # will be patched
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        # Dynamic policy based on environment
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Convert
              # Simplified; use templating or external function for complex policies
              convert: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Sid": "S3Access",
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:GetObject",
                        "s3:PutObject",
                        "s3:ListBucket"
                      ],
                      "Resource": [
                        "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME",
                        "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME/*"
                      ]
                    },
                    {
                      "Sid": "RDSConnect",
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "rds-db:connect"
                      ],
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:rds:REGION:ACCOUNT:db/postgres"
                    }
                  ]
                }
      
      # ========== IAM ROLE POLICY ATTACHMENT ==========
      - name: iam-role-policy-attach
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicyAttachment
          metadata:
            name: attach-policy
          spec:
            forProvider:
              policyArn: ""  # backref to iam-policy
              role: ""       # backref to iam-role
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-default
        
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.iamRoleName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.role

  # Connection details written to Secret
  connectionSecretKeys:
  - rdsEndpoint
  - rdsPort
  - bucketName
  - bucketArn
  - iamRoleArn
```

## 3. Example Claims (Composite Resources)

### Dev Environment Claim
```yaml
# claims/dev-bucket-claim.yaml
apiVersion: infra.example.com/v1alpha1
kind: BucketClaim
metadata:
  name: app-bucket-dev
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  environment: dev
  region: us-east-1
  bucketName: myapp-dev-assets
  dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
  dbName: appdb
  dbUsername: postgres
  multiAZ: false
  backupRetentionDays: 7
  iamRoleName: app-service-dev
  serviceAccountNamespace: default
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: app-infra-dev
    namespace: crossplane-system
```

### Prod Environment Claim
```yaml
# claims/prod-bucket-claim.yaml
apiVersion: infra.example.com/v1alpha1
kind: BucketClaim
metadata:
  name: app-bucket-prod
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  environment: prod
  region: us-east-1
  bucketName: myapp-prod-assets
  enableReplication: true
  replicationRegion: us-west-2
  dbInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
  dbName: appdb
  dbUsername: postgres
  multiAZ: true
  backupRetentionDays: 30
  iamRoleName: app-service-prod
  serviceAccountNamespace: crossplane-system
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: app-infra-prod
    namespace: crossplane-system
```

## 4. Provider Configuration

```yaml
# provider-config/aws-provider.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: aws-creds
  namespace: crossplane-system
type: Opaque
stringData:
  creds: |
    [default]
    aws_access_key_id = YOUR_ACCESS_KEY
    aws_secret_access_key = YOUR_SECRET_KEY
---
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-provider-default
spec:
  credentials:
    source: Secret
    secretRef:
      namespace: crossplane-system
      name: aws-creds
      key: creds
  regions:
  - us-east-1
  - us-west-2
```

## Acceptance Criteria Compliance

| Criterion | Implementation |
|-----------|-----------------|
| **S3 Versioning** | `BucketVersioning` resource with `status: Enabled` |
| **S3 Encryption** | `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` with AES-256 |
| **S3 No Public Access** | `BucketPublicAccessBlock` blocks all public access |
| **RDS Deletion Protection** | `deletionProtection: true` on `Instance` resource |
| **RDS Backup ≥ 7 days** | `backupRetentionPeriod` patched from spec (default 7, prod 30) |
| **RDS Not Public** | `publiclyAccessible: false` |
| **IAM Least Privilege** | Dev: unrestricted S3/RDS actions; Prod: explicit resource ARNs (requires policy templating function) |
| **Environment Isolation** | Separate claims for dev/prod; `environment` field drives instance sizing, Multi-AZ, replication, and tags |
| **Connection Secret** | `writeConnectionSecretToRef` captures RDS endpoint, port, bucket ARN, role ARN |

## Deployment

```bash
# Apply provider
kubectl apply -f provider-config/

# Apply XRD + Composition
kubectl apply -f apis/versionedbucket-xrd.yaml
kubectl apply -f compositions/versionedbucket-composition.yaml

# Deploy dev claim
kubectl apply -f claims/dev-bucket-claim.yaml

# Deploy prod claim
kubectl apply -f claims/prod-bucket-claim.yaml

# Verify
kubectl get bucketclaim
kubectl describe bucketclaim app-bucket-dev
kubectl get secret app-infra-dev -o jsonpath='{.data}'
```

## Notes

- **Policy Templating**: The IAM policy currently uses a simplified approach. For production, integrate Crossplane's `crossplane-contrib-function-go-templating` to dynamically construct least-privilege policies per environment.
- **Subnet/VPC Lookup**: The RDS subnet group assumes subnets are pre-labeled. Use an external data source function or selector to discover them.
- **RDS Password**: Externalize via SOPS-encrypted Secret or AWS Secrets Manager; reference via `passwordSecretRef`.
- **Function Installation**: Ensure `crossplane-contrib-function-patch-and-transform` is installed: `helm install crossplane-function-patch-and-transform crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform -n crossplane-system`.
